criterion: DoD CC SRG IL5 - FIPS 140-2/140-3 validated cryptography (SC-13, FedRAMP+): every cryptographic function in code/config (password hashing, token signing/HMAC, random/session IDs, TLS client/server settings, image/manifest crypto settings) must use FIPS-validated modules and FIPS-approved algorithms; MD5/SHA-1 or non-FIPS libraries for security functions are gaps.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - CUI handling and marking (DoDI 5200.48; MP-3/AC-16 as applicable): the application must mark CUI it outputs (API responses, exports, UI pages) with a CUI banner/marking and must not write CUI to logs, error messages or non-boundary destinations.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - DoD PKI / CAC authentication (IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-2(12), IA-5(2)): user authentication must use DoD PKI (CAC/PIV) via the inherited DoD PKI / Keycloak IdP; local password-only or shared static API-key authentication for users or admins is a gap.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner (AC-8): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): the standard DoD Notice and Consent Banner text must be displayed/returned before access and require acknowledgement; missing or non-standard text is a gap.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - audit record content (AU-2, AU-3, AU-3(1), AU-12, FedRAMP+ parameters): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): every security-relevant event (logon success/failure, lockout, privileged action, data read/change, session timeout) must record actor, action, object, source IP, UTC timestamp and outcome.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - audit retention (AU-11, FedRAMP+ parameter): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): 1 year online retention; log storage is platform-inherited, so code/config must emit audit records to the platform collector (stdout/structured) and must not configure local truncation/rotation that discards records before collection.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - session termination / idle timeout (AC-11, AC-12, SC-23): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): 15-minute idle timeout enforced server-side for tokens/sessions; session tokens must expire and be invalidated on logout.
DoD CC SRG IL5 - unsuccessful logon attempts (AC-7): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): lock the account after 3 consecutive invalid attempts within 15 minutes, for 15 minutes.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - password-based authenticators where still used (IA-5(1), FedRAMP+ parameters): ISSM parameters (docs/il5/00-boundary.md): minimum 15 characters, 60-day maximum lifetime, 24-generation history, stored only as FIPS-approved salted hashes.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - protection of authenticators and keys (IA-5, SC-12, SC-28 for secrets): no secrets, API keys or signing keys hard-coded in source, Dockerfile or Kubernetes manifests (including plaintext env values); load from Kubernetes Secrets/external secret store.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - transmission confidentiality/integrity (SC-8, SC-8(1)): CUI must be protected in transit with TLS 1.2+ using FIPS-approved ciphers end to end; code/config must not disable TLS verification or expose plaintext HTTP listeners outside the pod without platform TLS termination documented.

DoD CC SRG IL5 - privileged access restricted to vetted (US persons) administrators (AC-6, AC-6(5), PS-3 FedRAMP+): privileged/admin functions must be role-gated and configurable (no hard-coded admin accounts or bypasses) so the platform/IdP can restrict them to authorized US-person administrators.
